title: Run the Duplicate Check
subtitle: Compare the invoice against everything already paid
scenario: It is 11:00 AM. Two records are on your desk: the Invoice Record for INV-58831 and the Payment History. Before the desk spends a cent, run the check that compares them: has this exact bill been paid before? Produce the duplicate-check record that clears it - or would flag it.
input: Invoice Record: INV-58831, vendor V-1042, total 1220.00. Payment History (day-0): INV-58790 (V-1042, 980.00) and other vendors' prior payments. Identity key = vendor id + invoice number + invoice total. Compare the invoice's identity against every paid invoice.
instructions: Restate the invoice's identity: vendor id, invoice number, invoice total.
Decide whether that identity appears in the Payment History (foundInHistory).
Set isDuplicate from that finding, and record the decision.
Return one valid JSON object. Use true/false for the flags.
copilotPrompt: Produce a duplicate-check JSON record for this invoice: invoiceNumber, vendorId, invoiceTotal, foundInHistory, isDuplicate, and decision. Compare the identity key (vendor + invoice number + total) against the payment history.
successMessage: Duplicate check complete. INV-58831 is not in the history - cleared to continue matching.
editorHelper: Compare the invoice's identity to the paid history and record the result.

intro.heading: Before you pay: is this already paid?

sections.title: The cheapest error to prevent
sections.body: Paying the same invoice twice is common and expensive. The duplicate check runs before the money moves, comparing this invoice's identity against everything already paid.

sections.title: Identity, not a single field
sections.body: The check uses vendor id + invoice number + total together. INV-58831 for V-1042 at 1220.00 is a specific bill; no single field would identify it reliably.

sections.title: Clear, then keep matching
sections.body: INV-58831 is absent from the history, so foundInHistory is false and isDuplicate is false. Clearing the duplicate check does not skip the three-way match - it just rules out double payment.

sections.title: What you produce here
sections.body: A small duplicate-check record: the identity you compared, whether it was found, the resulting flag, and the decision. It is the evidence the desk did check.

fieldGuide.meaning: Whether that identity appears in the Payment History.
fieldGuide.hint: INV-58831 is not in the day-0 history, so this is false.

fieldGuide.meaning: Whether this invoice is a duplicate of an already-paid one.
fieldGuide.hint: Follows directly from foundInHistory - not found means not a duplicate.

fieldGuide.meaning: The routing decision from the check.
fieldGuide.hint: Not a duplicate means the invoice is clear to keep matching.

takeaway.heading: Duplicate check complete
points: You compared the invoice's identity - vendor id + invoice number + total - against the paid history.
INV-58831 is absent, so foundInHistory and isDuplicate are both false and the decision is clear.
The flags are stored as true/false so the match decision can route on them without re-reading prose.
The duplicate-check record is saved as evidence the desk checked before paying.
The workflow can now rule out paying any invoice twice before it reaches the match decision.
